itemList.description: Testing / Inspection, Repairing, reconditioning, cleaning, and water servicing of the English and Kannada alphabet LED Name Boards displaying the word “EXHIBITION” and I LOVE MYSURU. The scope of work includes the provision and operation of a suitable crane/Scaffolding to ensure safe access and execution of all required tasks as per direction of Engineer In-Charge.
